authenticity_review: The image exhibits high-quality rendering of fur texture and lighting, creating a convincing plush toy aesthetic. However, structural artifacts are present. The animal pose auditor flagged a MEDIUM risk level with ~29% low-confidence keypoints, particularly in the limbs of the smaller koalas and the interface between the central and left koalas. Visually, the baby koala's lower body lacks clear definition and appears to merge with the surface/background (structural collapse), and there is slight boundary fusion between the large central koala and the left medium koala. These anatomical ambiguities prevent a perfect authenticity score, though the overall image remains coherent.
key_defects: Count mismatch: Only 4 koalas/toys visible instead of requested 5.
Structural ambiguity in baby koala's lower limbs (melting/fusion with background).
Minor boundary fusion between central and left koala arms.
Simplified anatomy lacking specific biological checkpoints (opposable thumbs, sharp claws) due to plush style.
